summary: Steel Aermotor fire tower on Scrub Oak Mountain in the Lackawanna State Forest, built 1921 and removed in 1989 per FFLOS; no source describes the site today.

facts.design: Steel Aermotor tower (FFLOS); a 1959 survey describes a four-legged steel structure with a glass-enclosed cab

events.note: Built in 1921 per FFLOS; a July 1921 item said the Pennsylvania department of forestry would erect steel towers that summer, one of them on Scrub Oak Mountain
A November 24, 1921 newspaper item says 813 visitors registered at the tower in the previous month, the largest count for any one tower
Registered on FFLOS September 16, 2008, nominated by Henry Isenberg

corrections.why: The July 1921 item quoted on the Forest Lookouts page says the Pennsylvania department of forestry would erect the towers. Lackawanna State Forest is where the tower stood, so it is a location rather than an agency.

notes_for_editor: The 1921 build date and the 1989 removal come from FFLOS; the 1921 announcement and the 813-visitor item are newspaper items quoted on Forest Lookouts and were not read at the original papers. The 64-foot height and cab description are from a 1959 survey station description quoted on Forest Lookouts; the survey describes the tower as standing then, which is the only description of its structure. The brief's agency field is corrected to the Pennsylvania Department of Forestry, the body the 1921 item names. Nothing found on what remains at the site today or on public access. A search result for a North Pocono Historical Society Facebook post mentions the road to this tower being closed; the post did not load in fetch_text, so it is a lead only and not used. No photos found. Brief coordinates (41.3815, -75.5935) not checked against a source.
